newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Computer Forms buys trading co.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Computer Forms buys trading co.

text.p: Malaysian printer Computer Forms (M) Bhd said it has completed the acquisition of the entire shareholding of Chip Seng Trading (Holdings) Sdn Bhd.
The announcement was made in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
Computer Forms had announced on June 19 that it would be acquiring the company for 66 million ringgit to be paid in cash.
The company said the acquisition was being made to enhance its core activities of manufacturing computer forms, stock certificates and other related paper products.
Computer Forms stock, which had been suspended at the company's request, was requoted on Thursday. The shares rose 10 cents to 18.40 ringgit in late morning trading.
